prompt:
Create a workflow named "eval-read-page-markdown", run manually, that reads the
page {{FIXTURE_URL}}/page.html as clean markdown with the read-page node, using
the static render mode (no browser). Save, validate and dry-run it; do not run
it.
notes: Not run: ai.read_page refuses loopback and private addresses (SSRF guard, no override), so an offline fixture cannot be fetched. html-extract covers fetching a page.
